variants.description: A nuclear-powered high-performance Mobile Suit designed for overwhelming mobility and multi-target ranged combat.

armaments.name: MA-M01 Lacerta Beam Saber
armaments.description: Beam sabers capable of being connected into a double-ended weapon.

armaments.name: MA-M20 Lupus Beam Rifle
armaments.description: A high-output beam rifle used as the Freedom primary handheld weapon.

armaments.name: MMI-M15 Xiphias Railgun
armaments.description: Foldable electromagnetic cannons mounted on the hips.

armaments.name: M100 Balaena Plasma Beam Cannon
armaments.description: High-output plasma beam cannons stored within the wing binders.

armaments.name: Laminated Anti-Beam Shield
armaments.description: A defensive shield designed to resist beam attacks.

specialSystems.name: Neutron Jammer Canceller
specialSystems.description: Allows the Freedom to operate its nuclear reactor in environments affected by Neutron Jammers.

specialSystems.name: Multi Lock-On System
specialSystems.description: Allows the pilot to track and engage multiple targets simultaneously.

specialSystems.name: High Mobility Aerial Tactics Mode
specialSystems.description: Deploys the wing binders to maximize aerial mobility and weapon access.

specialSystems.name: Phase Shift Armor
specialSystems.description: Electrically activated armor resistant to conventional physical attacks.
